title: The Baptism of Christ
alt: Jesus stands with hands together in prayer, hip-deep in a stylised river, with a bearded man in a fur-like garment on a rocky bank to one side touching his head and two winged angels on the other, against a gleaming gold background. In a blue half-circle at the top, a bearded man in a white robe hovers over the scene, lifting his right hand towards Jesus and holding a book with a red cover.

title: Portrait of a Quaker
alt: A man in a three-quarter view portrait looks at the viewer. He has a round face with gentle features, fair skin and white hair styled in eighteenth-century fashion, and wears a dark coat with gold buttons, a light waistcoat and a white cravat with ruffled edges, against a plain, dark background.
